data.title: Marble Clock Corridor
data.style: Cinematic suspense cue with steady 100 BPM pulse, sparse ticking percussion, quiet synth bass, and cold ambient pads; verse-like motion stays restrained and mechanical, then tension rises through filtered swells, glassy reverses, and subtle low-end pressure, with no melody climax or drum drop. Intimate, sterile, and darkly polished mix with wide reverb and crisp transient detail., steady, slow, ambient
